newsitem.title: CROATIA: SOCCER-CROATIA SQUAD FOR WORLD CUP MATCH VS GREECE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIA SQUAD FOR WORLD CUP MATCH VS GREECE.

text.p: The Croatia squad for their World Cup European group one qualifier against Greece in Salonika on April 30 was announced on Tuesday as follows:
Goalkeepers - Drazen Ladic (Croatia Zagreb), Tonci Gabric (Hajduk Split), Marijan Mrmic (Besiktas, Turkey)

Defenders - Goran Juric (Croatia), Zvonimir Soldo (Vfb Stuttgart, Germany), Dario Simic (Croatia), Slaven Bilic (West Ham, England), Dubravko Pavlicic (Hercules, Spain), Robert Jarni (Real Betis, Spain)

Midfielders - Zvonimir Boban (AC Milan, Italy), Aljosa Asanovic (Derby County, England), Robert Prosinecki (Sevilla, Spain), Niko Kovac (Bayer Leverkusen, Germany), Nikola Jurcevic (Freiburg, Germany), Krunoslav Jurcic (Croatia)
Strikers - Alen Boksic (Juventus, Italy), Davor Suker (Real Madrid, Spain), Goran Vlaovic (Valencia, Spain), Igor Cvitanovic (Croatia), Silvio Maric (Croatia), Igor Pamic (Saucheaux, France)
